items.headline: Automatic Debiased Machine Learning for Smooth Functionals of Nonparametric M-Estimands
items.summary:
arXiv:2501.11868v3 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: We develop a unified framework for automatic debiased machine learning (autoDML) for inference on a broad class of statistical parameters. The framework applies to any smooth functional of a nonparametric M-estimand, defined as the minimizer of a population risk over an infinite-dimensional linear space.
